title: 第12章 谢太公
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

以世子之身，担任少宰，开府建衙，佐治一国军政。

这是直接让自己去管理整个邦国，提前把统治权交到自己这个世子手中啊！

“父亲，这……”

“别想太多。”

似乎是看出了祁澜的疑虑，祁云顿时摆了摆手，轻松道：

“为父只是看你先开琥珀晶糖之法，为我邦国盈利诸多财货，又设堆肥、沤肥之法，可使粮食大增，兼之行事沉稳有度，于治国之上颇有才干，他日或有伊尹、傅说之能，若有才思可利于邦国，当有权柄尝试、推行。“

伊尹、傅说都是大商王朝历史上知名的宰执之臣，不仅在治国上很在行，也在其他领域有着很高成就。

前者改进青铜器制造，还精通酿酒、调味、烹饪，是中医历史上的汤剂始祖，后者改进版筑术，在城防、道路、建筑建设商有许多开创之法。

祁澜从饴糖上弄出黄冰糖，又规范改进肥料，可使粮食产量大增，长溪子爵拿这两名大贤对标祁澜，可以说恰当，也可以说是很高的赞誉了。

”孩儿晓得了，只是邦国事务繁杂，少宰身负多责，只怕……”

祁澜冲着老爹拱了拱手。

“无需担忧，你爹我还是晓得，你如今的重心，得放在武道之上，勇猛精进，治国理政的琐事，为父可还没老，且自有诸大夫辅佐，你只需在你认为需要动用这份权力的时候去用就行。”

“多谢父亲。”

当夜，长溪子府前堂灯火通明，人声鼎沸。

大飨，就是所有人一起庆祝的大宴会，有着礼仪规格的要求。

说是大飨，规模自然比不上那些大诸侯，但对长溪邦来说，已经是一年到头也没几回的盛事。

堂上，几尊大鼎分列，烹煮猪羊。

宗室长辈、卿大夫、军司马、各家武士，连同邑内有头有脸的匠师和富户，坐满了前堂和两侧的偏厅。

酒过三巡，气氛正热。

“少君武道精进，十六入地境，实乃我长溪数代以来头一人，当浮一大白！”

有宗室长辈举起陶爵，高声贺道。

祁澜端着酒爵起身回敬，一饮而尽。

这种场合，他要做的就是喝酒、受贺、表现出稳重和大度，别的倒也不用多说。

正喝着，一个拄着鸠杖的身影从偏厅那边慢悠悠地踱过来。

谢颂，谢太公。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As the crown prince, he served as the young prime minister, opened a government office, and managed the military and political affairs of the country.

This is to directly allow himself to manage the entire country and hand over the power of governance to his prince in advance!

"Father, this..."

"Don't think too much."

Seemingly sensing Qi Lan's doubts, Qi Yun immediately waved his hand and said relaxedly:

"As a father, I just want you to discover the method of amber crystal sugar first, which will bring a lot of wealth to our country. You will also develop the method of composting and retting, which can greatly increase the food supply. At the same time, you will act calmly and moderately, and you will be quite talented in governing the country. In the future, you may be able to do what Yi Yin and Fu Shuo said. If you have talents and ideas that can benefit the country, you should have the authority to try and implement them."

Yi Yin and Fu Yue were both well-known ministers in the history of the Shang Dynasty. They were not only good at governing the country, but also had high achievements in other fields.

The former improved the manufacturing of bronzes, and was also proficient in brewing, seasoning, and cooking. He was the ancestor of decoctions in the history of traditional Chinese medicine. The latter improved the art of building and built many innovative methods in city defense, roads, and building construction.

Qi Lan made yellow rock sugar from malt sugar and standardized and improved fertilizers, which could greatly increase grain production. Viscount Changxi compared these two great sages to Qi Lan, which can be said to be appropriate and highly praised.

"I understand, kid. It's just that the affairs of the country are complicated and the young master has many responsibilities. I'm afraid..."

Qi Lan cupped her hands towards her father.

"No need to worry, your father, I still know that your focus now must be on martial arts, bravery and diligence, and the trivial matters of governing the country. My father is not old yet, and he has many doctors to assist him. You only need to use this power when you think you need to use it."

"Thank you father."

That night, the front hall of Changxizi Mansion was brightly lit and full of people.

A feast is a big banquet where everyone celebrates together, and it has etiquette requirements.

Although it is said to be a grand feast, the scale is naturally not comparable to that of the great princes, but for Changxi State, it is already a rare event throughout the year.

In the hall, several large cauldrons are lined up, cooking pigs and sheep.

Clan elders, ministers, army commanders, warriors from various families, as well as prominent craftsmen and wealthy households in the town, filled the front hall and the side halls on both sides.

After three rounds of drinking, the atmosphere was getting hot.

"Young Master has advanced in martial arts and entered the realm of the earth at the age of sixteen. He is actually the first person in Changxi in several generations. It's a revelation!"

An elder from the clan raised the Tao Jue and congratulated loudly.

Qi Lan stood up with the wine in hand and drank the wine in one gulp.

On this occasion, all he had to do was drink, receive congratulations, show stability and magnanimity, and there was not much else to say.

While he was drinking, a figure leaning on a dove staff walked slowly over from the side hall.

Thank you for your praise, thank you Taigong.
